description: This script manages power and fault LEDs on a device, providing functions to retrieve LED identifiers and control their states based on system events such as preinitialization, failsafe mode, and upgrade process.

methods.name: get_status_led
methods.description: Finds and returns the filename of the status (power) LED.

methods.name: get_failsafe_led
methods.description: Finds and returns the filename of the failsafe (fault) LED.

methods.name: set_state
methods.description: Sets LED states based on the provided system state parameter (preinit, failsafe, preinit_regular, upgrade, done).
